battle.name: 法國大革命戰爭
battle.theater: 巴黎市區與法國東北邊境
battle.brief: 一七九二年四月，法國革命政府向奧地利宣戰，大革命戰爭自此拉開，至一八〇二年《亞眠條約》才落幕。巴黎街頭的長槍隊伍在一七九二年八月十日迎著瑞士衛兵的刺刀而上，聯軍一方的長槍連則一直用到一七九〇年代末才被線列步兵取代。

kit.name: 長槍
kit.history: 方陣的長矛讓火槍隊站在後面。密西西比之後，長矛和火槍一起站住了。

countries: 交戰的一方是法蘭西共和國，另一方是反法同盟的聯軍。法國方面，革命政府把國民警衛軍改編為志願兵與線列步兵並存的兵制：一七九二年春，靠各省國民自衛軍的志願兵與城市民兵上前線，隨著戰事延長，志願兵被整編進正規營，營下設連，每連人數在一百上下；步兵用燧發滑膛槍配刺刀，砲兵分騎乘與步兵兩種，野戰主力是四磅與十二磅銅砲，攻城另備二十四磅及更大口徑的重砲，騎兵有胸甲騎兵與輕騎兵。聯軍方面，奧地利軍按軍團編制，步兵營內並列火槍手連與長矛兵連，槍兵與火槍手同列成排；普魯士軍沿用斜線陣攻入洛林，步兵營不帶長矛，全線裝刺刀；英國派出的遠征軍以步兵營、騎兵旅與獨立的皇家砲兵連組成，一七九〇年代中期之前仍有幾個團列在「長槍與火槍」團的名冊上；西班牙王國與撒丁王國一七九三年才正式加入；荷蘭共和國起初站在法國一邊，巴達維共和國於一七九五年成立後才轉向聯軍，其步兵連隊中仍保留攜槍的分隊。戰爭後期聯盟幾經重組，一七九九年的英俄奧聯軍與一八〇〇年的奧普聯軍先後接手戰線，而法國的西班牙戰線、萊茵戰線與北意戰線則一直由共和國軍獨力承擔。
countriesEn: One side was the French Republic, the other the coalitions ranged against it. On the French side the revolutionary government turned the National Guard into a system in which volunteers and line infantry existed side by side: in the spring of 1792 the front was filled by the volunteers of the departmental National Guard and by the urban militia, and as the war went on these volunteers were absorbed into regular battalions, each battalion being divided into companies of about a hundred men. The infantry used flintlock muskets with bayonets; the artillery was split into horse and foot, with four-pounder and twelve-pounder bronze guns as the field pieces and twenty-four-pounder and heavier siege guns kept separately; the cavalry consisted of cuirassiers and light cavalry. On the coalition side, the Austrian army was organised in corps, with the infantry battalion containing fire companies and pike companies side by side, pikemen and musketeers standing in the same ranks; the Prussian army kept the oblique order of battle when it marched into Lorraine, its infantry battalions carried no pikes and used bayonets throughout; the British expeditions were made up of infantry battalions, cavalry brigades and an independent Royal Artillery, and until the middle of the 1790s several regiments still stood on the rolls as pike-and-shot regiments; the Kingdoms of Spain and Sardinia entered formally only in 1793; the Dutch Republic began on the French side, and only after the Batavian Republic was founded in 1795 did it turn to the coalition, its infantry companies still retaining pike sections. Later in the war the alliances were repeatedly reshuffled, the Anglo-Russian-Austrian force of 1799 and the Austro-Prussian force of 1800 taking over in turn, while the Spanish, Rhine and north Italian fronts were carried by the republic's own armies.
people: 法國方面的人物分屬兩個世代。掌巴黎的國民自衛軍司令拉法耶特把城內武裝平民編成有縱隊、有砲列的隊伍，但他在拒絕對民眾開火之後於一七九二年八月十日前離開巴黎；當日真正指揮攻擊的是巴黎公社的作戰委員會，委員中有軍人、公職人員與劇作家，其中以桑特－茹斯特最積極，巴黎的攻勢即由這個委員會推動。邊境上的指揮官是克勒曼、克拉克、莫羅與迪穆里埃：克勒曼在瓦萊頂住聯軍的攻勢，迪穆里埃在低地以密集縱隊夜襲荷蘭城鎮，莫羅隨後接掌共和國邊防；拿破崙·波拿巴在土倫之圍後以炮兵指揮官的身份嶄露頭角，一七九六年在意大利擊敗奧軍，一七九八年遠征埃及，一七九九年霧月政變奪取政權。聯軍方面，奧地利一七九二年由科堡公爵統率，其後由欣克爾德元帥接手法國戰區；普魯士一七九二年的入侵由不倫瑞克公爵統率，耶根伯爵在冬季戰役中橫穿萊茵，把法軍切斷在後方；英國由霍爾上將在海上主事，封鎖了地中海的港口，陸軍在佛蘭德斯一線由約克公爵等人督率。海爾德遠征則由英國海軍與巴達維部隊合作，英國分艦隊在丹赫爾德灣迫降荷蘭艦隊。聯盟內部的分歧同樣左右戰局：倫敦的皮特主張議和與扶植巴伐尼亞，維也納與柏林的少數派則主張對法開戰，兩種政策在同一個聯盟裡互相抵消。
peopleEn: The French figures belong to two generations. Lafayette, commander of the National Guard, organised the armed population of the capital into columns with guns attached, but after refusing to fire on the crowd he left Paris before 10 August 1792; the actual command of the attack that day lay with the executive committee of the Paris Commune, composed of soldiers, officials and a playwright, with Saint-Just the most active among them, and the day's offensive was driven by that committee. The commanders on the frontier were Kellermann, Clarke, Moreau and Dumouriez: Kellermann held the coalition at Valmy, Dumouriez took the Dutch towns by night with dense columns, and Moreau afterwards took charge of the republic's frontier. Napoleon Bonaparte came to the fore as an artillery commander after the siege of Toulon, defeated the Austrians in Italy in 1796, campaigned in Egypt in 1798 and seized power in the coup of 18 Brumaire in 1799. On the coalition side Austria was led in 1792 by the Duke of Coburg, and the French front was later taken over by the Marshal Hlinkede; the Prussian invasion of 1792 was commanded by the Duke of Brunswick, and Count Yorck crossed the Rhine during the winter campaign, cutting the French forces behind. In Britain Lord Hood directed affairs at sea, blockading the Mediterranean ports, while the army in Flanders was led by the Duke of York and others. The Helder expedition was a joint operation of the British navy and the Batavian troops, the British squadron forcing the Dutch squadron to surrender in the bay of Den Helder. Divisions inside the alliance shaped the war as much as battles: Pitt in London pressed for a negotiated peace and for the support of Bavaria, while the minority in Vienna and Berlin called for war, and the two policies cancelled each other out within a single coalition.
kits: 長槍在這場戰爭裡的位置很特別：它既是開戰前夜仍在巴黎街頭流通的舊式冷兵器，也是一七九〇年代各國軍隊陸續廢除的最後一件長柄步戰兵器。法國方面，革命議會在一七九一年底的軍制改革中讓線列步兵一律改用火槍配刺刀，長槍自此退出建制；但巴黎的武器庫與槍械鋪裡長槍數量極多，工匠與自衛軍手上仍有大量冷兵器，一七九二年八月十日攻擊杜樂麗宮的隊伍就是以長槍對付西班牙籍瑞士衛兵的刺刀——那支衛兵在路易十六治下才剛剛放下長槍改裝刺刀，兩種兵器的對撞因此成了整場戰爭的象徵。聯軍方面，奧地利步兵的每個營仍並列火槍手連與長矛兵連，一七九二年在洛林與凡爾登方向、1794 年在查理羅伊與弗萊爾斯前沿推進的攻擊縱隊，前排就是握著三米多長長槍的槍兵；英軍這邊，第四十三步兵團與第五十二步兵團是最後兩支攜帶長槍的團，第五十二團在佛蘭德斯戰役中仍列在「長槍與火槍」團的名冊上，一七九五年兩團先後改裝，長槍在英軍中就此消失；一七九三年封鎖土倫的皇家海軍陸戰隊在突擊縱隊中亦攜槍作戰；荷蘭的巴達維軍隊則把長矛連保留到一七九九年海爾德遠征前後。真正決定戰局的是火槍、刺刀與銅砲：法軍的格里博瓦爾四磅與十二磅野砲在弗萊爾斯與查理羅伊的連續砲火決定了攻勢的去向，攻城靠二十四磅重砲與臼砲，騎兵配馬刀與胸甲，糧秣、砲車與傷員的運輸則靠馬車隊。
kitsEn: The position of the pike in this war is peculiar: it was at once an old cold weapon still circulating in the streets of Paris on the eve of the war, and the last long-handled infantry weapon to be abolished by the armies of Europe during the 1790s. On the French side, in the military reorganisation at the close of 1791 the revolutionary assembly put line infantry on muskets with bayonets, and the pike left the order of battle; but the workshops and armourers' shops of Paris held enormous numbers of them, and artisans and National Guardsmen still carried a great deal of cold weaponry, so that the columns that attacked the Tuileries on 10 August 1792 met the bayonets of the Spanish Swiss Guard with pikes in their hands. That guard had only just put down its pikes and taken up bayonets under Louis XVI, and the collision of the two weapons became the image of the whole war. On the coalition side the Austrian battalion still stood fire companies beside pike companies, and the assault columns that advanced through Lorraine in 1792 and towards Charleroi and Fleurus in 1794 had pikemen holding pikes over three metres long in their front rank; in the British army the 43rd and 52nd Regiments of Foot were the last two to carry pikes, the 52nd still appearing on the rolls as a pike-and-shot regiment in the Flanders campaign, and both were converted in 1795, after which the pike disappeared from the British army; the Royal Marines blockading Toulon in 1793 also went into their assault columns with pikes; and the Batavian army kept its pike companies until around the Helder expedition of 1799. What actually decided the fighting was the musket, the bayonet and the bronze gun: the continuous fire of the Gribeauval four- and twelve-pounders decided the course of the attack at Fleurus and Charleroi, siege work depended on twenty-four-pounder guns and howitzers, the cavalry carried sabres and cuirasses, and the carriage of powder, guns and wounded was the work of wagon trains.
tactics: 法國的戰術核心是密集縱隊與刺刀。革命軍放棄了長矛支撐的方陣，改以十數列縱深的縱隊行軍與攻擊：一七九二年十一月六日夜，迪穆里埃部下的縱隊在雨夜中攻入熱馬普與埃爾蒙的荷蘭城鎮，縱隊前端的刺刀在狹窄街道上展開得比火槍有效；同年九月瓦萊與十月的熱馬普，志願兵與線列步兵的混編縱隊把奧軍的長槍方陣正面擊穿。聯軍方面，普魯士沿用斜線陣，一七九二年由洛林直插凡爾登，砲兵集中後再以步兵縱隊捲入缺口；奧地利則以長槍方陣配合縱隊攻擊，1794 年六月十八日強攻查理羅伊失利，攻擊縱隊在法軍接連的十二磅砲火下被切斷，退回時仍以長槍與火槍齊射掩護。巴黎的戰鬥又是另一套規矩：密集的人手、狹窄街巷與屋頂上的射擊使長槍與火槍都可在近距離內齊射，八月十日的攻擊正是靠成百上千人同時推擠長槍把衛兵的刺刀陣壓垮；一七九五年芽月十二日的巴黎起義與牧月一日起義重演了同樣的打法，起義者用長槍與短管火槍在街口築起障礙，最後被巴雷率領的政府軍以刺刀與砲火壓下去。攻城方面，1793 年九月聯軍夜襲埃吉耶特堡壘失利，說明以縱隊衝擊帶刺刀工事的守軍同樣不靈；一七九九年海爾德遠征靠海軍封鎖與登陸縱隊切斷荷蘭艦隊，同樣的結果反過來動搖了英荷同盟。
tacticsEn: The core of the French method was the dense column and the bayonet. The revolutionary armies gave up the pike-supported square and marched and attacked in columns ten or more ranks deep: on the night of 6 November 1792 the columns of Dumouriez entered the Dutch towns of Jemappes and Ermon in the rain, where the bayonets at the head of the column worked better than muskets in the narrow streets; in September at Valmy and in October at Jemappes the mixed columns of volunteers and line infantry broke straight through the Austrian pike square. On the coalition side the Prussians kept the oblique order, driving from Lorraine towards Verdun in 1792, massing their guns and then rolling infantry columns into the gap; the Austrians combined the pike square with the attack column, and their assault on Charleroi on 18 June 1794 failed, the attacking columns being cut apart by the continuous twelve-pounder fire of the French and retiring behind a covering fire of pike and musket volleys. The fighting in Paris followed different rules: the density of the crowd, the narrowness of the streets and shooting from the roofs allowed both pikes and muskets to fire in mass at close range, and the attack of 10 August worked precisely because hundreds of men pushed their pikes forward together and bore down the bayonet line of the guard; the Paris rising of 12 Germinal and the rising of 1 Prairial in 1795 repeated the same method, insurgents building barricades at the street mouths with pikes and short muskets, until they were put down by the government forces under Barras with bayonets and guns. In siege work the night attack on the Fort l'Éguillette by the allies in September 1793 failed, showing equally that columns could not break a defender behind breastworks bristling with bayonets; and the Helder expedition of 1799 relied on the blockade of the sea and a landing column to cut off the Dutch squadron, and its outcome in turn shook the Anglo-Dutch alliance.
data: 可以核對的數字大致如下。戰爭自一七九二年四月二十日法國向奧地利宣戰起，至一八〇二年三月二十五日《亞眠條約》生效為止，前後近十年；一七九三年一月二十一日法國再向英國與荷蘭宣戰，一七九三年七月十三日第一次反法同盟成立，同年九月十三日法軍收復土倫，一七九四年六月二十六日弗萊爾斯之戰法國取勝，第一次聯盟隨之瓦解；一七九五年四月二十一日巴黎和約、一七九七年十月坎波福爾米奧和約與一七九八年拉施塔特和約，逐一同英、西、奧各國收尾；一七九八年八月一日金字塔戰役、一七九九年六月二十一日阿布基爾海戰與八月二十七日荷蘭艦隊在丹赫爾德投降，第二次同盟在歐洲大陸與地中海同時崩解；一八〇〇年三月五日克魯阿、六月十四日馬倫哥與十二月三日霍恩林登，決定了法國在歐洲的霸權；一八〇一年二月九日《盧內維爾條約》與一八〇二年三月二十五日《亞眠條約》先後把戰爭收尾。兵力方面，瓦萊戰役法軍集結約五萬上下，聯軍在邊境上的總兵力通常被記作接近九萬；弗萊爾斯一戰法軍常被記為八萬至十萬人，聯軍兩支軍團合計約四萬六千；馬倫哥法軍約二萬八千、奧軍約三萬三千；海爾德遠征的英軍登陸部隊約一萬三千人，另有荷軍與德意志援軍。裝備方面，法國革命軍在開戰之初可用野砲數目有限，許多是從城鎮與海港徵用的舊砲，野戰主力是一七九二年起已大量裝備的格里博瓦爾四磅與十二磅銅砲；長槍的長度通常在三米半到四米之間，長矛兵連在奧地利步兵營中約佔一半。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war ran from the French declaration of war on Austria on 20 April 1792 to the coming into force of the Treaty of Amiens on 25 March 1802, close to ten years in all; on 21 January 1793 France declared war on Britain and the Netherlands; the First Coalition was formed on 13 July 1793, and the French retook Toulon on 13 September of the same year; the French victory at Fleurus on 26 June 1794 brought the first coalition down, and the separate peace of 21 April 1795, the Treaty of Campo Formio of October 1797 and the settlement of Rastatt in 1798 wound the war up with Britain, Spain and Austria in turn; the battle of the Pyramids on 1 August 1798, the battle of Aboukir Bay on 21 June 1799 and the surrender of the Dutch squadron at Den Helder on 27 August 1799 broke the second coalition at once in continental Europe and in the Mediterranean; Crouat on 5 March 1800, Marengo on 14 June and Hohenlinden on 3 December settled the question of French predominance in Europe; the Treaty of Lunéville of 9 February 1801 and the Treaty of Amiens of 25 March 1802 then closed the war. On strength: the French at Valmy are put at about fifty thousand, with the coalition on the frontier usually given as close to ninety thousand; the French at Fleurus are commonly given as between eighty and a hundred thousand against some forty-six thousand in the two coalition corps; at Marengo about twenty-eight thousand French faced some thirty-three thousand Austrians; the British landing force in the Helder expedition was about thirteen thousand men, with Dutch and German contingents besides. On equipment: the revolutionary army had few field guns of its own at the outset, many of them old pieces taken over from towns and seaports, while the field artillery backbone was the Gribeauval four- and twelve-pounder bronze gun, in service in quantity from 1792; pikes ran from about three and a half to four metres in length, and the pike companies made up roughly half of an Austrian infantry battalion.
cause: 打起上來有內外交織的兩層原因。表層是外交與王朝的尊嚴：革命議會把主權歸於國民、廢除封建特權、把教會土地收歸國有，奧地利、普魯士與西班牙的君主視之為對君主國秩序的挑戰；法國則指責奧地利收容流亡貴族、煽動境內反革命貴族，一七九二年四月二十日先向奧地利宣戰，同年八月又向撒丁王國宣戰。內層是法國自身的生存條件：王室被廢、天主教會受迫害的消息在歐洲各國宮廷中迅速流傳，聯盟成立與英國對荷蘭海峽的封鎖使法國感到四面受敵；革命造成的貴族外流與資產階層的恐慌，把大量中產家庭推向革命的另一邊；長期戰爭帶來的通脹與物價上漲，軍費與徵募的壓力又落回政府身上，於是法國在一七九三年八月二十三日頒布全民徵兵令，把整個國家直接動員起來。戰爭因此不只是王室的爭端，而是第一次把國家安全與國民身份綁在一起的衝突；革命軍隊走向國外，則是為了把革命的內部矛盾轉移出去。
causeEn: The war came out of two layers of cause, external and internal. On the surface lay diplomacy and the dignity of the dynasties: the revolutionary assembly placed sovereignty in the nation, abolished the feudal privileges and took the church lands into national ownership, and the monarchs of Austria, Prussia and Spain read this as a challenge to the order of the monarchies; France in return accused Austria of harbouring the émigré nobility and of stirring revolt among the counter-revolutionary nobles inside France, declared war on Austria on 20 April 1792 and added Sardinia in August of the same year. Beneath that lay the conditions of French survival: the fall of the royal house and the persecution of the Catholic Church were reported rapidly in the courts of Europe, the formation of the coalition and the British blockade of the Dutch approaches made France feel encircled on every side, the flight of the nobility and the panic of the propertied classes drove large numbers of the middle ranks to the other side of the revolution, and the inflation and rising prices that a long war brought, together with the pressure of military costs and recruitment, fell back on the government, which on 23 August 1793 issued the decree of the levée en masse and mobilised the nation outright. The war was therefore not merely a dispute between crowns, but the first conflict to bind national security to the identity of the people; and the fact that the revolutionary armies marched abroad was in part an attempt to carry the internal tensions of the revolution out of the country.
impact: 這場戰爭把戰爭的樣本徹底改寫了。徵兵令把農民變成兵員，國民議會獎勵陣亡者的家庭，戰爭第一次不只是王朝的事業而是全體國民的事：法國用人口代替僱傭兵，憑數量在萊茵與北意壓倒聯軍，同一套兵制也在拿破崙手上變成師團與軍團的模板。技術層面上，法軍全線改用刺刀，長槍在歐洲主要軍隊中於一七九五年前後陸續消失，英軍、奧軍、荷軍各自在這十年裡清掉了冷兵器的最後一份裝備；砲兵因格里博瓦爾系統的銅砲與四磅、十二磅兩級野砲而有了新標準，攻城與野戰的火力結構自此可以計算，築城技術也在法國的實踐中被重新整理。制度與思想層面上，革命把民法、世俗化與公民兵役制帶出國境，也把民族主義與被壓迫民族整合的問題帶了出來，激起波蘭、萊茵與北意的反抗，同時讓保守各國在反法的旗號下聯合。戰爭的代價在法國內部以鎮壓、審查與臨時政府的形式出現，革命軍隊同時是革命軍隊與恐怖時期的執行者；而一七九九年霧月政變之後，戰爭的走向就由軍人而不是議會決定。
impactEn: The war rewrote the whole model of war. The levée en masse turned peasants into soldiers, the assembly rewarded the families of the dead, and for the first time a war was not the business of dynasties but of the whole nation: France substituted numbers for hired troops, beat the coalition in the Rhineland and in northern Italy on mass alone, and the same system of service became the template for divisions and corps in Napoleon's hands. On the technical side the French army went over to the bayonet throughout, and the pike disappeared from the principal armies of Europe within a few years of 1795, the British, Austrian and Dutch services each clearing out the last of their cold weapons during the decade; artillery acquired a new standard with the bronze guns of the Gribeauval system and its two field calibres of four and twelve pounds, so that the fire structure of siege and field could be calculated, and fortification was recast by French practice. On the institutional and intellectual side the revolution carried civil law, secularisation and the citizen-soldier beyond the frontier, and carried with it the questions of nationalism and the consolidation of subjected peoples, raising revolt in Poland, on the Rhine and in northern Italy, while at the same time giving the conservative powers a common ground in the anti-French cause. The costs of the war appeared inside France in the form of repression, censorship and the government of the Terror, the revolutionary army being at once the army of the revolution and the instrument of the Terror; and after the coup of 18 Brumaire in 1799 the direction of the war was settled by soldiers rather than by parliament.
result: 結果是法國贏了這場戰爭，卻把革命的紅利消耗在戰場上。第一次反法同盟在一七九四年的弗萊爾斯之後瓦解，一七九五年巴黎和約、一七九七年坎波福爾米奧和約與一七九八年的拉施塔特和約分別同英、西、奧各國收尾；法國拿下了荷蘭（一七九五年成立巴達維共和國）、萊茵左岸並扶植受法國影響的萊茵邦聯，北意出現傀儡政權，遠征埃及與敘利亞又把地中海東岸拉進新的局面。第二次同盟在敘利亞與地中海失敗：金字塔與阿布基爾之後英國收復埃及，一七九九年海爾德遠征雖佔了荷蘭沿岸，卻因荷蘭艦隊在丹赫爾德被英軍迫降而喪失英荷互信，1800 年克魯阿、馬倫哥與霍恩林登之後奧地利求和，一八〇一年《盧內維爾條約》把法國的東界推到萊茵，一八〇二年《亞眠條約》結束英法戰爭，戰爭在整整十年後才真正收尾。代價同樣清楚：法國財政被國債壓垮，海外佔領地處處響起叛亂，革命政府把徵兵與鎮壓推到了極點；而拿破崙在一七九九年奪權之後把這場戰爭接手過去，用它的兵制、經驗與榮譽把自己推向一八〇四年的加冕，戰爭的勝利因此變成新政權的資本，也變成下一場更大戰爭的伏筆。
resultEn: The result was that France won the war while spending the dividend of the revolution on the battlefield. The first coalition broke up after Fleurus in 1794, and the separate peace of 1795, the Treaty of Campo Formio of 1797 and the settlement of Rastatt in 1798 wound the war up with Britain, Spain and Austria in turn; France took the Netherlands, where the Batavian Republic was founded in 1795, held the left bank of the Rhine and presided over a confederation of Rhenish states, puppet regimes appeared in northern Italy, and the campaigns in Egypt and Syria pulled the eastern Mediterranean into a new situation. The second coalition failed in Syria and in the Mediterranean: after the Pyramids and Aboukir Britain recovered Egypt, and although the Helder expedition of 1799 occupied the Dutch coast, the surrender of the Dutch squadron at Den Helder destroyed the trust between Britain and Holland; after Crouat, Marengo and Hohenlinden in 1800 Austria sued for peace, the Treaty of Lunéville of 1801 pushed the eastern frontier of France up to the Rhine, and the Treaty of Amiens of 1802 ended the war between France and Britain, so that the conflict was not truly closed until ten years had passed. The costs were equally plain: the finances of France were crushed under the national debt, the occupied territories rose in revolt one after another, and the revolutionary government pushed conscription and repression to their limit. Napoleon, having seized power in 1799, took the war over and used its system of service, its experience and its glory to carry himself to the coronation of 1804; the victory of the war thus became the capital of the new regime, and the seed of the next and greater war.
